name: MR MAGEBOY
description:
About This Game

MR MAGEBOY is an incremental game about an aspiring mage with a simple dream. Build a thriving resource business and help the village prosper along the way.

Journey through the portal on magical expeditions, where you’ll use your Harvest Spell to gather plants, enchanted roots, ore, and increasingly rare resource variants. Bring your haul home, stock the market, and turn it into gold. Expand your inventory, increase your selling speed, transmute resources into more valuable forms, and gradually automate your growing business.

No mage should adventure alone! Discover and collect magical Companions throughout the game, each with its own unique appearance and personality. Your Companion is your familiar, you can travel with only one at a time, but you’re free to return to the village and choose a new favorite whenever you like. Companions are purely visual, so you can pick whichever one belongs by your side without worrying about stats or advantages.

Resources aren’t the only things waiting beyond the portal. Fight dangerous monsters with your Attack Spell, collect the Monster Cores they leave behind, and use them to unlock powerful upgrades for your spells, portal, and village.

Every expedition brings new opportunities to grow stronger. Explore a huge branching skill tree and shape your build around the things you value most, harvesting power, combat damage, rare resources, movement speed, health and mana, market capacity, automation, and much more.

Unlock new levels and biomes, from enchanted forests to shadowy caves, each with its own resources and increasingly dangerous monsters.

Push farther, gather faster, and return richer, but keep an eye on your health and mana, or your expedition may end sooner than planned!
short_desc: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!
